runs.name: choose
runs.command: thinkthen choose 'Which team owns this?' billing shipping account < parcel.txt
runs.input: My parcel has been stuck in transit for a week.
runs.see: The stuck parcel goes to shipping.

runs.name: choose-split
runs.command: thinkthen choose --details 'Which team owns this?' billing shipping account < both.txt | jq -r '.answer.probabilities|tojson'
runs.input: My parcel never came, and now I cannot log in to track it.
runs.see: The message is about a parcel and a login, so shipping and account share the probability.

runs.name: choose-null
runs.command: thinkthen choose --threshold 0.9 'Which team owns this?' billing shipping account < both.txt
runs.input: My parcel never came, and now I cannot log in to track it.
runs.see: No team reaches 0.9, so choose prints null and exits 3.

runs.name: choose-raw
runs.command: thinkthen choose --raw --lines 'Which team owns this?' --option 'billing=Invoices, fees, and refunds.' --option 'shipping=Parcels and delivery.' --option 'account=Logins and passwords.' < requests.txt
runs.input:
Please refund the extra fee on my invoice.
My parcel went to the wrong address.
I cannot reset my password.
runs.see: Each request goes to the team its description names, printed bare with no quotation marks.
